text: Quick recap. Epithelium is packed cells on a basement membrane, with no blood vessels. Connective tissue is few cells in a lot of matrix. Tendons are collagen and join muscle to bone; ligaments are elastic and join bone to bone. Cartilage has no blood supply; mammalian bone has Haversian systems. Muscle is striated, cardiac or smooth, and in a contracting sarcomere the A band stays the same. And in a neuron, dendrites bring impulses in, the axon carries them out, myelin makes them jump, and the synapse is one way.
